noun_definition: web refers to the online interface where users can access their profile and display name after logging in.
Display name refers to the user’s name that is expected to be visible on the profile page after logging back in using a previously copied link.
Logout refers to the action of terminating a user's session on the website, which is followed by an attempt to revisit a page that should display the user's profile information.
current page refers to the specific web page that the user navigates to after logging back in using a previously copied link.
